centre.reprime_invitation: Today, the center you are working with is the emotional: feeling, sharing, descending into the heart. Not with your head. Knowing is not enough — contact doesn't have to be known first either.

dynamique_ego.passion_explication: Not a stinginess with money. A stinginess of self: of your energy, your time, your presence, what you know. You hold back, you protect, because it seems to you that you don't have enough.
dynamique_ego.compulsion_evitement: Avoiding being invaded, dispossessed, drained of one's resources.

essence.qualite_phrase: You don't have to know everything to be safe — you are already in connection with the real.
horizons: Coming out of observation to be inside
Sharing a resource, and seeing that it doesn't diminish
Touching the inner richness that cannot be calculated

intentions_du_matin: Come out of my head at least once
Engage my body in a concrete action
Share a bit of myself, without calculating everything
Hold a conversation beyond what's necessary
Have the experience before analyzing it
Receive a presence, without dissecting it
pratiques_du_matin: Before noon, call someone without having prepared what you'll say.
One physical thing — a walk, a stretch, a gesture — to inhabit the body.
Leave home without an intellectual destination. Just be in the world.
When asked for something, say yes faster than you normally would.
Eat slowly, taste the food, don't read while eating.
Share a thought out loud — not to explain it, so it exists outside of you.

zones.description: Engaged presence. You know AND you feel. You share your resources, and they renew themselves. Your knowledge serves the encounter.
You observe, you analyze — you notice the reflex to withdraw but you can choose to engage in contact.
You retreat into your tower. Contact exhausts you. You accumulate knowledge but flee feeling. The world becomes hostile.
Total isolation, paranoia, depersonalization. The body is no longer there. A very heavy day that calls for a gentle, concrete connection.

details_riso.texte: Pioneer, visionary, present. You perceive what others don't see, and you embody it.
Observer, perceptive, curious. You see clearly without withdrawing.
Expert, focused, deep. Your knowledge serves something.
Thinker, conceptual. You begin to favor the idea over experience.
Detached, isolated, secretive. You keep to yourself, you economize, you calculate your commitments.
Provocative, nihilistic, contemptuous. You attack from a distance.
Cynical, antagonistic, eccentric. The world is an enemy.
Paranoia, hallucinations, disconnection from the body. Withdrawal becomes psychosis.
Schizoid, total depersonalization. Asking for help is vital here.

passions.label: I kept a thought to myself alone
I avoided a contact that required heart
I wanted to know before acting

pieges.label: I hid behind a screen or a book
I appeared cold without meaning to
I didn't speak because I wasn't an expert

moments.label: I committed without having planned everything
I shared a part of myself, simply
I felt without needing to understand
I gave someone my time, generously
I felt the richness in me, which cannot be calculated
The world felt alive to me, not threatening
I let go of a piece of knowledge to have the experience

evenements_a_relire.label: I kept something to myself that wanted to come out
I moved from my head to my body

remedes.label: The body — inhabiting what one has
Humility of knowledge — accepting not to understand

matin: Morning begins. Do you want to descend into the body today?
A day opens — can you bring your presence to it?
What do you want to share — even a little?
midi: You are in the middle of the day. Are you in your head or in life?
Here you are. Does someone deserve your time now?
A pause is possible. But let it be inhabited, not a refuge.
soir: The day fades. What did you let in?
You can just come, without needing to understand.
The evening is gentle. A sharing, if possible.
nuit: The night watches. A feeling, then sleep.
You are still here, and that is already shared.
